item.title: 【Requests】[REQ CAP] - Jamie Cullum - Pianoman at Christmas Stream
item.description:
Jamie Cullum and his big band return to the Royal Albert Hall to perform his festive, perennial album The Pianoman at Christmas

121 mins - 2025

Jamie is joined on stage by the big band including the talents of Kansas Smitty’s featuring the Mercury nominated Joe Webb, the show promises to deliver a festive, fun and furious set with all the trimmings. Fans can expect unique collaborations and to be taken on a journey from the romantic, solo piano ballads of "Beautiful Together" and "Christmas Don’t Let Me Down" to the instant classics "Hang Your Lights" and "It’s Christmas"

Streaming at https://stage.playerplus.com/product/jamie-cullum-xmas-2025 but requires purchasing to view, and no offline playback/download.

Available until 12 January 2026
